User_Story: As an organizer, I want to create an event with a capacity and a registration window so that attendees can sign up.
Notes: DynamoDB domain. capacity + seatsReserved counter; status DRAFT/OPEN/SOLD_OUT/CLOSED.

User_Story: As an organizer, I want to publish an event so that registration opens within its window.
As an organizer, I want to add sessions to an event so that attendees can plan their day.
Notes: DynamoDB domain. GSI1 by eventId. Per-session capacity.

User_Story: As an attendee, I want to register for an event so that I can attend.
Notes: DynamoDB domain. Persist REQUESTED. GSI1 eventId, GSI2 attendeeId. No duplicate non-cancelled reg per event.

User_Story: As an attendee, I want to view my registrations with cursor pagination so that I can manage them.
Notes: Query GSI2 (attendeeId), cursor paginated. Golden Rule #16 — no offset.

User_Story: As the system, I want registration to synchronously verify the event is OPEN and within its window before persisting so that nobody registers for a closed event.
Notes: ACL — apply sync-cross-service-call skill. IEventValidator validates status + window. getOutboundHeaders() (#24). Golden Rule #14.

User_Story: As the system, I want a registration to atomically reserve a seat asynchronously so that two attendees cannot claim the last seat.
Notes: Saga step 1 — apply choreography-saga skill. registration publishes REGISTRATION_REQUESTED; event-event-handler runs ReserveSeatUseCase (conditional atomic increment seatsReserved<capacity); replies SEAT_RESERVED | SOLD_OUT. Idempotent.

User_Story: As an attendee, I want to be confirmed or waitlisted when the seat check returns so that I know if I am in.
Notes: Saga step 2. registration-event-handler consumes SEAT_RESERVED/SOLD_OUT; REQUESTED->CONFIRMED | WAITLISTED. Replay = no-op (do not reserve twice).

User_Story: As an attendee, I want to cancel my registration so that my seat is freed for the waitlist.
Notes: POST /registrations/:id/cancel publishes SEAT_RELEASED; event handler frees a seat and may promote head of waitlist. Idempotent.

User_Story: As an organizer, I want a webapp dashboard of events with capacity/sold-out badges so that I can monitor sign-ups.
Notes: Thin-orchestrator page + data-table + status-variants.ts. data-testid: events-table.

User_Story: As an attendee, I want a webapp page to browse open events and register so that I can self-serve.
Notes: Client hooks in client-common. Form via react-hook-form + Zod from @old-st/contracts/registration.

User_Story: As an attendee, I want a mobile screen to register and show my ticket QR so that I can check in on site.
Notes: Reuses client-common hooks. Expo screen. Note: + mobile.
